items.statement: The submitted three selected transition states are frequency-characterized, with minima distinguished from TSs and one relevant imaginary mode for each TS or a justified equivalent.
items.expected: Per-step frequency evidence and state assignments are reported.

items.statement: Each selected TS is connected by IRC or equivalent path analysis to the stated neighboring states.
items.expected: Per-step connectivity evidence identifies both endpoints.

items.statement: The barrier sequence for radical addition, cyclization and selenium-anion capture is approximately 8.9, 7.6 and 6.2 kcal/mol, respectively.
items.expected: Three numeric barriers are reported with step identities and units.
